guideline.welcome_text: This platform helps OKU users, employers and JKM officers manage employment and welfare information in an organised way.
guideline.choose_role_text: Choose the relevant card to see the steps and features available to you.
guideline.role.oku_user_text: Complete your profile, submit documents, find job opportunities and manage welfare applications.
guideline.role.employer_text: View your linked organisation records, manage jobs and export permitted information.
guideline.role.jkm_officer_text: Review verification, manage OKU and employer records, and generate reports.
guideline.steps_intro: Follow these steps in order. You can return to this guideline at any time.
guideline.oku.1_title: Create an account or log in
guideline.oku.1_text: Register as an OKU user or use the account provided to you.
guideline.oku.2_text: Check your personal details, OKU category, education and contact information.
guideline.oku.3_text: Add an image of your OKU card through the Career Profile page.
guideline.oku.4_text: When identity verification is enabled, upload clear images of the front and back of your MyKad.
guideline.oku.5_text: Monitor the verification status. You will be asked to resubmit documents when necessary.
guideline.oku.6_text: Browse jobs, record your interest and manage your welfare applications.
guideline.oku.7_text: Generate permitted exports for your records. Every export is audited and expires.
guideline.employer.1_text: Register with your organisation email and log in.
guideline.employer.2_text: An authorised administrator must link your account to an employer record.
guideline.employer.3_text: View the organisation, workers and employment records within your access scope.
guideline.employer.4_text: After linking, create and update job vacancies for your organisation.
guideline.employer.5_text: Review permitted employment relationships for your organisation.
guideline.employer.6_text: Generate organisation or employment reports according to your account permissions.
guideline.officer.1_title: Log in with an officer account
guideline.officer.1_text: Use the account provided by an authorised administrator.
guideline.officer.2_text: Open identity reviews and inspect documents according to your permissions.
guideline.officer.3_text: Search, create and update the relevant OKU records.
guideline.officer.4_text: Update employer, job and employment relationship records.
guideline.officer.5_text: Review case status, record decisions and schedule follow-up reviews.
guideline.officer.6_text: View employment and welfare statistics and export permitted reports.
guideline.support_text: Use the FAQ on the welcome page or contact your system administrator if your role access is incorrect.
guideline.language_text: You can switch between Bahasa Melayu, English and 中文 at any time.
guideline.onboarding.1_text: MyOKUcare helps you manage OKU, employment and welfare information in one place.
guideline.onboarding.2_text: OKU users can submit an OKU card and, when required, MyKad images for secure review.
guideline.onboarding.3_text: View jobs, organisations, workers and documents according to your role and permissions.
guideline.onboarding.4_text: Use Bahasa Melayu, English or 中文（简体） and change your choice at any time.
guideline.onboarding.5_text: You can reopen this tutorial from System Guideline after you log in.
guideline.welcome_section_text: Choose your role and follow short visual instructions before logging in.
